entries.clue: Antipodean milk coffee, smoother than a cappuccino and barely capped in foam.
A tenant in this rank held straight of the king, no lord between
Slim handle and a throwaway blade, peeled from a sterile pack
Overstretched ligament, treated with rest rather than a blade
Burn and weigh the silver to prove it, as the king's dues required
Rumble of contentment, never heard from a cat on the table
Dysplasia in a young Alsatian shows up first in this joint
Espresso cut with an equal splash of warm milk
Short, restricted pull, thicker and sweeter than standard
Single measure of espresso, ordered double by anyone flagging.
Franchise of holding a local court and pocketing its profits
'Waste' over and over in its entries, the great county north of the Humber
